auftrag: Three people tell Agent Wren what they did on Monday. Listen carefully. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: On Monday I left the Academy at half past six and had a coffee with an old friend.
At eight o'clock I came back, because I had forgotten my glasses.
In the corridor on the second floor I met Mr Hale.
He was carrying a heavy bag and looked very nervous.
He told me he was just leaving, and he hurried down the stairs.
On Monday I closed the café at nine and cleaned the kitchen.
At ten o'clock a tall man came in.
He wore a hat and gloves and kept looking over his shoulder.
He asked me to keep a small parcel in the locker for a friend from London.
I did not see his face clearly.
On Monday I finished work at six and went straight home.
I cooked dinner, watched a film and went to bed early.
I did not come back to the Academy, and I did not see anybody.
Somebody must have stolen the compass, wrapped it in a green cloth and run away with it.

raetsel.frage: Who says what? Put each sentence with the right person.

aussagen.text: I came back because I forgot my glasses.
I closed the café at nine.
The man wore a hat and gloves.
I did not see anybody on Monday evening.
I watched a film and went to bed early.
I met Mr Hale in the corridor.

raetsel.hilfe1: Read the three statements again. Who says "I"?
raetsel.hilfe2: Dr Cole is at the Academy. Sam is at the café. Mr Hale is at home.

raetsel.frage: Two of these sentences cannot both be true. Which two?
optionen: Sam closed the café at nine.
Mr Hale was at home all evening.
Dr Cole had a coffee with an old friend.
Dr Cole met Mr Hale at the Academy at eight.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look for two statements about the same evening and different places.
raetsel.hilfe2: Dr Cole says she met Mr Hale at the Academy. Mr Hale says he was at home.

raetsel.frage: Why is the sentence about the green cloth strange?
optionen: A green cloth is too expensive.
Nobody told Mr Hale about the cloth, but he knows it.
Dr Cole says the cloth was blue.
raetsel.hilfe1: Remember the locker in the café. Who has seen the cloth?
raetsel.hilfe2: Only Agent Wren and the trainee saw it. How does Mr Hale know?

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Dr Cole believes that Mr Hale was just leaving the Academy.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Read what Dr Cole says Mr Hale told her.
raetsel.hilfe2: Mr Hale told her something. But does she believe him? The text does not say.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Mr Hale tells his story. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: On Monday I ___ work at six and ___ straight home. I ___ dinner, ___ a film and ___ to bed early. I ___ nobody.
raetsel.hilfe1: Mr Hale tells about Monday. Monday is over.
raetsel.hilfe2: Finished action = past form. "Go" becomes "went". "See" becomes "saw".
